item.description: Aid provided by the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, commonly referred to as SNAP, was cut in October. item.description: Government Shutdown Update After a 43 day long shutdown, the longest in U.S. history, the federal government reopened Wed. Nov. 12, 2025. item.title: Anti-Ice Protests Happening Across the Nation
item.description: Protests and demonstrations against Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) have been occurring throughout the country. Protests have grown after a Minnesota resident, Renee Good, was fatally shot by an ICE officer in a heated exchange. Crowds gathered in cities across New York, Texas, Philadelphia, Connecticut, Washington, Massachusetts, Colorado, Oregon, California, North Carolina and Minnesota. item.title: Integration at Meredith College
item.description: In observance of Black and Women’s History Months, Sophomore Miranda Johnson reached out to The Herald in hopes of discussing the history of integration at Meredith, and celebrating our first Black female student.
